title: Known base defect audit entry v1
description: One line of <slug>.audit.jsonl. Entries are only appended; each carries the digest of the previous one, so removing or editing one breaks the chain (scripts/defects check).

n.description: Position in the trail, from 1; entries are only ever appended.

by.description: Who changed it: a tool (defects, the gate) or a lane.

action.description: registered, observed, routed, resolved, verified or reopened.

prev.description: The digest of the previous entry (defects.genesis_digest for the first).

digest.description: defects.digest_algorithm of this entry without digest, chained through prev.
